headline: Turkey-Ukraine Free Trade Agreement Enters Into Force
summary: Turkey confirmed that its bilateral free trade agreement with Ukraine has officially entered into effect alongside four other international pacts.
why: Free trade agreements reduce tariffs and expand market access between trading partners.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: Enactment of trade pact facilitates duty-free commercial flows between the signatory countries.
